words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) re-enters the already named garden before anything inside it is named. The attached feminine suffix keeps the scene tied to the garden of 88:10, and the fused word carries both governor and referent without repeating the garden noun. {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the relation interior presence, not ownership or movement from outside, so provision feels enclosed and accessible inside the domain. Because the prepositional phrase is fronted as the predicate of a verbless clause, the listener first receives a place-frame, then the delayed {{ar:عَيْنٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿaynun}}), and only at the end its flowing quality. The repeated locative also answers the previous ayah: the same interior where idle speech is absent in 88:11 is now filled with a visible source. Even the pause after {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) helps keep container and content distinct before the spring enters, and the smooth final sound releases into the source word rather than collapsing the two.

words.prose: {{ar:عَيْنٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿaynun}}) is the delayed subject that appears only after the garden interior has been opened. Its nominative indefiniteness introduces a fresh source rather than a named landmark, plural set, or distributed water system, and its singular form concentrates the garden's abundance into one focal water-eye. The broad {{ar:ع ي ن}} ({{tr:ʿ-y-n}}) field can move through eye, visible point, exact thing, and spring, but the frame {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) plus the adjective {{ar:جَارِيَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:jāriyatun}}) selects the spring branch while preserving the idea of provision visibly emerging from a witnessed aperture. The noun also sits as a hinge: it receives the locative frame and then carries the flowing adjective, so the source itself is perceived before motion becomes its attached quality. Its compact onset and matching indefinite ending bind it audibly to the adjective while still making the source a focused point. Within the surah it reverses the earlier {{ar:عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿaynin ʾāniyatin}}) of 88:5, changing a governed source-complement of imposed drinking into a present interior feature; against 55:50, the paired running-spring formula is compressed into one focal spring with adjectival flow. The word therefore launches the positive inventory after 88:11 as a visible, newly introduced, structurally central abundance point.

words.prose: {{ar:جَارِيَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:jāriyatun}}) closes the ayah by making motion belong to the spring itself. Its feminine singular nominative indefiniteness agrees with {{ar:عَيْنٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿaynun}}), so it is an adjective inside one noun phrase, not a second subject, a separate object, or the vessel or young-woman branches of {{ar:ج ر ي}} ({{tr:j-r-y}}); its indefiniteness classifies the spring by flow rather than giving a fixed watercourse name. The active participle matters: instead of a finite verb saying that the spring runs at one moment, the form makes running an abiding, marked source-quality. The root's running and course field lets the water feel current, renewing, provisionally in force, and moving along a path rather than sitting as stored stock, while local grammar keeps the selected sense to literal flow and leaves causative or reciprocal pressures outside the surface. As the final word, it turns the nominal inventory scene into stable motion, with the cadence lengthening from source-point into continuing current. It also reverses the adjective slot of 88:5, where the spring was {{ar:ءَانِيَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʾāniyatin}}), and it compresses the broader running-water formula seen with rivers under gardens in 2:25 and running springs in 55:50 into a source-level image. After the useless speech excluded in 88:11, the close supplies productive motion and lets the positive garden inventory keep moving forward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun at word 2 is qualified by the feminine adjective at word 3, joining a source to active motion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The water-source branch identifies an issuing origin, while the flow branch makes transit rather than storage its defining condition.

activation_trace.role: The springing water-source supplies the physical origin from which the scene is replenished.
Running and flowing makes continuous outward motion the source's operative state.

changed_reading.before: There is a spring in the place.
changed_reading.after: There is an issuing source whose identity is continuous outward flow, not a static pool.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both the noun at word 2 and the adjective at word 3 carry resource senses in addition to the immediate water image.
baseline_models.mechanism: The choice-part sense of the noun and the continuing-grant sense of the adjective allow the current to function as maintained provision: the good is not merely possessed but kept available.

activation_trace.role: The choice or finest part makes the source a selected excellence rather than a generic object.
Continuing provision or grant turns motion into maintained availability.

changed_reading.before: The flowing water is one pleasant amenity.
changed_reading.after: The verse can present the choicest good as an allowance kept in circulation: provision defined by continuance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exact focus noun can denote watchful care, and its adjective can denote a thing actively running.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visual double exposure lies beneath the hydrological reading: the source is also an active eye, so the place appears watched over rather than merely watered.

activation_trace.role: The eye of watchful care gives the noun a protective, attentive presence.
Active running lets that watchfulness move through the scene instead of remaining a fixed gaze.

changed_reading.before: The line reports only a physical water source.
changed_reading.after: A secondary reading lets the flowing source act as mobile watchfulness, making the place attentive as well as fertile.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening's arrival, newly occurring event, and encompassing cover recast the focus current as an emergence: a channel comes into operation inside a scene otherwise characterized by what overtakes and covers.

activation_trace.role: The focus spring supplies the origin that can emerge within the encompassing scene.
The focus flow supplies the motion that the arriving channel releases.
The watercourse and opened path image turns arrival into the activation of a route for flow.
Coming to be after not being supplies the event-like emergence of the current.
The all-enveloping cover supplies the field through which the localized source becomes a counter-opening.

structural_cues: An event that comes and encompasses opens the sequence; the focus later appears as a compact nominal scene inside it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a watercourse, new occurrence, and encompassing cover; I infer that the source opens a live channel within that cover. A live alternative is that these remain separate opening-event and garden images.

changed_reading.before: The spring is a settled feature already present.
changed_reading.after: The spring is also an event of access: a route comes into operation and keeps issuing within an encompassing reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier source belongs to passive administered drinking and a reached terminal condition; the focus repeats the source noun but replaces that relation with self-sustaining motion. The contrast is therefore agency and temporal condition, not merely two temperatures.

activation_trace.role: The repeated spring sense holds the object constant across the two scenes.
Self-running flow gives the focus source its contrasting open mobility.
Giving drink supplies an externally administered relation between drinker and source.
The identical spring branch makes the differing modifier and syntax carry the contrast.
Reaching the appointed limit supplies a terminal, intensified condition opposed to ongoing transit.

structural_cues: The same indefinite source noun occurs in 88:5 and 88:12, first governed by passive drinking and later presented existentially with a flowing modifier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies administered drink, the repeated source, reached limit, and flow; I infer a contrast between imposed intake and freely available self-motion. The narrower alternative is simply a contrast between two kinds of spring.

changed_reading.before: This is a pleasant counterpart to an earlier unpleasant spring.
changed_reading.after: This is a counter-source whose freedom consists in running openly rather than being administered from a source fixed at terminal intensity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failed food is defined by its inability to sustain or fill, followed by a state of good condition. Against that sequence, the focus branch of continuing grant makes the current an efficacious supply rather than decorative abundance.

activation_trace.role: The water-source gives the provision a concrete replenishing origin.
Ongoing provision makes the flow durative and effective rather than ornamental.
Provision, livelihood, and good condition establish the function that the denied food fails to perform.
Sufficiency identifies the missing effect against which the continuing source is measured.
The empty belly supplies the unmet need that distinguishes real provision from mere intake.
Good condition supplies the positive bodily and affective result of efficacious provision.

structural_cues: Negated nourishment and continuing hunger immediately yield to faces in good condition before the focus source appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sufficiency, emptiness, good condition, and an ongoing grant; I infer that the focus current participates in the transition to sufficiency. It may instead be a sign of that state rather than its cause.

changed_reading.before: The source adds sensory abundance to the garden.
changed_reading.after: The source embodies provision that actually reaches and sustains its recipient, reversing intake that leaves need untouched.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purposeful movement followed by acceptance activates the keeping-pace branch of the focus adjective. The current can be read as provision that continues alongside completed effort, not a motionless wage deposited afterward.

activation_trace.role: The choice good supplies what responsive motion continually makes available.
Keeping pace gives the current a responsive relation to another directed movement.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end supplies the motion with which the current keeps pace.
The non-dominant mapped acceptance branch supplies the settled affective completion of that movement.

structural_cues: Satisfaction is explicitly attached to prior striving immediately before entry into the elevated garden scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful movement, acceptance, and keeping pace; I infer a responsive correspondence between striving and current. The alternative is that the spring is simply part of the result, with no mimetic relation to the effort.

changed_reading.before: The spring is a static reward reached after effort.
changed_reading.after: The spring is a reward still in motion, a current that keeps pace with and answers purposive striving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding exclusion of mixed, worthless sound opens an acoustic slot. The moving water can fill it as ordered nonverbal sound, so silence here is selective rather than absolute.

activation_trace.role: The water-source supplies a plausible positive sound-maker inside the otherwise purified soundscape.
Continuous flowing supplies the patterned acoustic current.
Auditory perception makes the preceding negation define what may enter the scene's hearing.
Mixed noisy sound identifies what is absent, allowing ordered flow to become the audible remainder.

structural_cues: The repeated locative construction links 'in it you hear no...' directly to 'in it is a flowing source.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, excluded noise, and moving water; I supply the claim that flow is audible. A live alternative is visual juxtaposition with no intended sound at all.

changed_reading.before: The focus begins a new visual inventory after a statement of silence.
changed_reading.after: The flowing source may be the ordered sound left audible when futile human noise has been removed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cups ready in assigned places, objects aligned, and coverings distributed convert the lone spring into the live supply of an arranged reception system. Flow connects source to use across a prepared field.

activation_trace.role: The spring supplies the central replenishing source for the prepared setting.
Flow supplies the distribution link between source and multiple points of use.
Handleless cups supply open receiving vessels suited to immediate communal use.
Placement in an assigned lower position makes the vessels ready endpoints rather than stored objects.
Alignment on an even line supplies deliberate order across the receiving space.
Scattering and distribution extend availability throughout the setting.

structural_cues: The focus participle is followed by a chain of raised, placed, aligned, and spread passive participles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a source, flow, vessels, placement, alignment, and distribution; I infer a service network connecting them. The alternative is a non-causal inventory of independently prepared amenities.

changed_reading.before: The spring is one item beside furniture and vessels.
changed_reading.after: The spring is the active supply within a deliberately distributed hospitality environment, linking abundance to ready access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to direct sight or insight reactivates the focus noun's eye senses. The spring becomes a landscape eye: visibly issuing water and simultaneously training the observer's own seeing.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face seeing gives the spring noun an epistemic layer of manifest encounter.
The spring sense keeps the visual activation grounded in the actual water-source.
Visible motion makes the landscape eye an event to inspect rather than a hidden abstraction.
Directing sight or insight activates both optical and reflective attention toward created forms.

structural_cues: After the garden inventory, the discourse explicitly turns the audience toward looking at concrete created forms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a spring/eye polysemy and directed seeing; I infer that the source itself participates in teaching perception. The alternative is that only the later created objects are targets of reflection.

changed_reading.before: The spring is an object available to sight.
changed_reading.after: The spring is also a landscape eye that makes abundance manifest and tutors the observer in how to look.

context_deltas.mechanism: A measured water-holding recess, elevation, upright boundaries, and an extended surface provide the geometry that makes flow intelligible. The source is no longer isolated scenery but a circulation point embedded in designed terrain.

activation_trace.role: The source supplies the water-entry point within the larger terrain system.
Running water translates the surrounding vertical and horizontal forms into a working gradient.
A shaped recess or well that retains water supplies the local holding form from which flow can issue.
Raising supplies vertical difference and potential head.
Erect prominent forms supply stable boundaries and channels in the terrain.
An even extended surface supplies the receiving plane across which water can spread.

structural_cues: The branchless interrogative root ك ي ف repeats at 88:17-20, directing attention to constructional manner without licensing a branch citation.
Raised sky, erected mountains, and spread earth form a vertical-to-horizontal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a water-holding recess and a sequence of raised, erected, and extended forms; I infer hydraulic connectivity and directional flow. The live alternative is a set of independent demonstrations of construction.

changed_reading.before: The spring flows by itself inside a bounded garden.
changed_reading.after: The spring is the visible outlet of a measured landscape system whose heights, barriers, and surfaces make circulation possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reminder that runs on the tongue and the explicit denial of controlling surveillance activate the envoy and habitual-course branches of flow. The source offers a model of guidance that circulates and remains accessible without forcing reception.

activation_trace.role: The open source supplies an available origin from which a non-coercive benefit may be taken.
The running agent or envoy lets the current model a message moving on an affair.
A continuing customary course gives circulation regularity without compulsion.
Remembrance running on the tongue supplies the communicative current.
Categorical negation removes domination from the messenger's assigned function.
The controlling overseer supplies the coercive role explicitly excluded from circulation.

structural_cues: The imperative to remind is immediately delimited by a negated controller construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verbal circulation, an envoy branch, and denial of control; I analogize the source's open flow to non-coercive guidance. The alternative is that the garden image and messenger instruction have no shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The spring is freely available physical provision.
changed_reading.after: The spring can also model guidance: a benefit sent into circulation and offered continuously, while forced reception is withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away and covering truth reverse the focus's direct-seeing and visible-source branches. The current becomes open evidence whose availability does not guarantee that a viewer will face or acknowledge it.

activation_trace.role: Direct face-to-face seeing makes the source an encounter with something manifest.
The visible flowing water-source grounds the epistemic reading in a concrete phenomenon.
Turning the back supplies the viewer's directional refusal of what is available to sight.
Covering truth supplies the cognitive occlusion opposed to the source's manifestness.

structural_cues: The earlier call to look culminates in a later pair of refusal actions: turning away and covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct seeing, a visible source, turning away, and covering truth; I infer that the source belongs to the field of evidence being refused. It may instead remain only a reward image outside that refusal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The flowing source is manifest because its water is visible.
changed_reading.after: The flowing source is manifest evidence: openness remains available even when a perceiver turns away and covers what was shown.

context_deltas.mechanism: One later root inventory holds sweet water, bodily abstention, withholding, and punitive pain together. That polarity activates the focus current as unwithheld sweetness: a supply whose beneficence lies in remaining open and moving.

activation_trace.role: The focus source gives the sweetness activation a concrete water body.
Ongoing grant makes the beneficial supply persist rather than close.
Sweet pleasant water supplies the positive pole latent beside the punitive surface use.
Withholding and weaning supply the closure that uninterrupted provision reverses.
Punitive pain supplies the explicit negative pole against which open sweetness becomes consequential.

structural_cues: The later verse repeats the punishment root as both verb and noun, intensifying a root whose inventory also contains sweet water and withholding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sweetness, withholding, punishment, and ongoing provision; I infer a polar relation in which the focus current is the unwithheld alternative. The text does not explicitly adjective the focus water as sweet, so sweetness remains activated rather than asserted.

changed_reading.before: The spring is beneficial because it is flowing water.
changed_reading.after: The spring is an unwithheld current of sweetness, opposed not only to painful water but to the act of cutting benefit off.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return to a homeward point and subsequent reckoning place the apparently open-ended current inside a larger circuit. Flow remains generous, but it is ordered movement with return and measure rather than directionless excess.

activation_trace.role: The spring is the identifiable origin to which a circuit of movement can remain related.
A regular course supplies ordered continuity rather than unbounded motion.
Return to a destination bends the forward current into a homeward circuit.
Counting and accounting supply measure and terminal intelligibility to the course.

structural_cues: The closing sequence orders return before account, giving movement a destination and then an evaluation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies regular course, return, and accounting; I infer a circuit-like relation and measured distribution. The alternative is that only human return is intended and the water's motion remains purely local.

changed_reading.before: The current suggests abundance through indefinite forward motion.
changed_reading.after: The current suggests ordered abundance: a regular circulation whose openness is compatible with return, destination, and measure.

changed_reading.after: The source can figure value made immediately present and continuously disbursed, a liquid grant that remains within an eventual account.

strongest_changes: The repeated spring in 88:5 turns the focus into a contrast of imposed, terminal-condition drinking versus openly self-running availability.
Failed nourishment and continuing hunger make the current efficacious provision rather than decorative abundance.
The sequence of vessels, placement, alignment, and distribution makes the source the live supply of a prepared hospitality field.
Looking, turning away, and covering activate the spring-eye as manifest evidence that can remain open while being refused.
Raised, erected, and spread created forms recast the current as the outlet of a measured landscape gradient.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots sustain several live mechanisms at once: hydraulic issuance, continuing provision, mobile watchfulness, responsive motion, and communicative circulation. Context intensifies rather than collapses that plurality; especially notable are the exact hostile-source counterpart, the sweetness/withholding/punishment polarity, and the non-dominant aperture branch.
remaining_uncertainties: The hydraulic link from the spring to the arranged cups and furnishings is reader-supplied rather than stated.
The acoustic, messenger, and accounting readings are coherent branch activations but may be analogical rather than syntactic.
The human double exposure strains the ordinary head-adjective parse and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The landscape sequence supplies geometry, but the causal arrow from that geometry to the focus flow is abductive.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Running spring as reversal of the hot spring.** Evidence: `ع ي ن` B006 springing water-eye; `ج ر ي` B001 running/flowing; earlier `ء ن ي` B003 heat limit and `س ق ي` B001 forced drink. Structural cue: same `عين` appears in both punishment and garden, but one is `آنية` and one `جارية`. Role: flow replaces heat-completion. Abductive move: water’s moral quality is shown by its motion and context. Reading change: the ayah reads as the restored function of water.

2. **Ongoing provision.** Evidence: `ج ر ي` B006 ongoing provision/grant; `ن ع م` B001 favor; `غ ن ي` B002 sufficing was negated for the punished. Structural cue: after satisfaction and high garden, the spring runs. Role: continuous flow becomes continuous sustenance. Abductive move: blessed provision is not a one-time cup but a maintained course. Reading change: `جارية` reads economically as ongoing grant, not only hydrologically.

3. **Visible source inside the looking pedagogy.** Evidence: `ع ي ن` B001 seeing eye, B002 face-to-face seeing; `ن ظ ر` B001 looking later; `ج ر ي` B007 keeping pace/running with. Structural cue: the surah later commands looking at created signs. Role: the spring is a visible sign whose flow keeps pace with the reader’s perception. Abductive move: what is enjoyed in the garden also teaches the structure of creation. Reading change: the ayah reads as both amenity and demonstrative sign.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The four `كيف` questions retroactively made the spring not just a reward-detail but part of the visible created order. It also intensified the contrast with the earlier `عين آنية`, where the same source-form was made punitive.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The spring is continuing provision rather than a one-time supply.** **Lexical:** `ع ي ن` B006, "the springing water-eye," and `ج ر ي` B001, flowing, together with B006, "ongoing provision or grant." **Cue:** the spring sits inside a sequence of sustained ease, satisfaction, shelter, quiet, couches, cups, cushions, and carpets in 88:8-16. **Role:** `عين` supplies the source, B001 supplies motion from it, and B006 gives that motion the temporal role of maintaining provision. **Abduction:** I infer that the flow services the surrounding habitat; no pipe or act of distribution is stated. **Reading change:** `جارية` means more than visually running water: it makes the garden's benefits renewable and continuous.

2. **The source-eye prepares the transition from enjoyment to inspection.** **Lexical:** `ع ي ن` B001, the seeing eye, and B002, direct seeing, coactivated with the spring branch B006. **Cue:** five ayat after the spring, 88:17 explicitly asks the audience to look (`يَنظُرُونَ`) at the camel and how it was formed. **Role:** the spring is a material source within the habitat, while the dormant seeing branches make "source" itself an object and instrument of attention. **Abduction:** I infer that the lexical eye primes the later command to inspect provisioning design. **Reading change:** the spring becomes an epistemic aperture: its visible flow invites inquiry into how life-supporting systems are made.

3. **Flow is a reliable course that ordered objects are arranged around.** **Lexical:** `ج ر ي` B002, "habitual course or way." **Cue:** fixed flow in 88:12 is followed by raised, placed, rowed, and spread furnishings in 88:13-16, each a participial state of deliberate spatial order. **Role:** the course branch supplies temporal regularity; the furnishings translate that regularity into stable spatial access. **Abduction:** I infer design coordination between water and objects from their sequence. **Reading change:** the ayah reads as the moving axis of an otherwise settled interior, regular circulation embedded in stable arrangement.

4. **The nearby camel clarifies that the spring answers dependence rather than displaying luxury alone.** **Lexical:** fixed `ع ي ن` B006 and `ج ر ي` B006 are sharpened by `ء ب ل` B002 in 88:17, "camels sufficing without water" through fresh herbage. **Cue:** the water source and the camel occur at opposite ends of the focus window. **Role:** the camel supplies a biological counter-model of water use; the spring supplies uninterrupted external availability. **Abduction:** I infer that their placement invites comparison between resilience under scarcity and abundance that removes scarcity. **Reading change:** the running spring reads as one designed solution to bodily dependence, made more visible by a creature designed to manage that dependence differently.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 88:13-16 confirmed the ongoing-provision reading by arranging stable uses around the flow. The strongest surprise came at 88:17: explicit looking activated the seeing-eye branches of `ع ي ن`, while the camel's `ء ب ل` B002 water-sufficiency supplied a contrasting biological solution to dependence on a running source.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, temel anlamı bir şeyin kendi yolu boyunca akması, koşması ya da ilerlemesi olarak kurar; su, at, rüzgar, güneş ve gemi bunun farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Gemi ve güneş için kullanılan adlandırmalar bu hareket çekirdeğine dayanır, fakat dalın tamamını yalnızca su akışına ya da yalnızca koşmaya indirgemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hareket çekirdeğini, türemiş biçimlerle belirli söz öbeklerinde görülen su, at, gemi, güneş ve pınar kullanımlarından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kendi yolu boyunca akarak, koşarak ya da düzenli biçimde ilerlemesidir. Su, at, rüzgar, güneş ve gemi bu hareketin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir; gemi ile güneşin hareketlerine dayalı adlandırmaları çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık kendi yolu boyunca akar, koşar ya da kesintisiz biçimde ilerler.
Su ve rüzgar akarak, at koşarak, güneş ile gemi ise izledikleri yol boyunca ilerleyerek çekirdeği gerçekleştirir.
Hareket eden gemi ve gökte ilerleyen güneş, bu ilerleme özellikleri üzerinden ayrıca adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, bir şeyin yatağında ya da izlediği yolda ilerlemesidir. Hızlı geçiş, suyun akışı, atın koşması, rüzgarın esip gitmesi, güneşin gökte yol alması ve geminin denizde ilerlemesi bu ortak çekirdeğin kapsamındadır.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.
